summary: EN lead uniquely details archaeal retinal-based photosynthesis and the Purple Earth hypothesis. PT uniquely notes endosymbiotic chloroplast origin and process timescales from seconds to seasons. DE uniquely provides Greek etymology and defines 'photosynthetische Effizienz'. All cover oxygenic/anoxygenic distinction and broad ecological role but vary in mechanistic and historical specifics.
